email.body1:
Michael, saw Lilt shipped a new suite of AI content products and brought on a new Chief Product and Technology Officer.

New product lines usually create fresh buying signals faster than ops can route them, and reps lose hours on research, writing, and CRM logging instead of selling. Our AI SDR turns signals into reviewed, personalized outreach with every email auto-logged: 3-5x more meetings per rep, no new headcount.

I built a personalized signal play for Lilt off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Michael, quick follow-up for Lilt.

Most RevOps teams I talk to know their signal-to-action latency is the bottleneck, but it is hard to see exactly where the handoff leaks before a lead goes cold. Our built-in best practices alone usually lift response rates 50 to 70 percent.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through a teardown of your current outbound, three specific things I would change, and how a signal play would close the latency gap for Lilt.
email.body3:
Michael, last bit of proof for Lilt.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Lilt's reply rate likely compares to other AI startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to Lilt either way.
